Maximum number of iterations reached. Number of iterations: 5.

explanation: Active-bound fitting uses Ceres rounds sharing one remaining iteration/time budget. At lines 938-942 each round appends its history (excluding the repeated initial entry) and subtracts consumed iterations. Result.iterations is the complete history length minus one (line 947). If the last Ceres round terminates NO_CONVERGENCE, line 949 retains its per-round message. Thus Number of iterations: 5 (larger F1-B) or 3 (smaller F1-B) is the final round, whereas native iterations=40 and history length=41 account for the full requested budget. All observations are Available and no trial failed. This establishes budget exhaustion, not physical-model failure or convergence. No additional fit or budget is authorized.
field_availability: Original native result serialization retained status, message, iterations, complete iteration_costs/iteration_seconds, evaluation counts, weighted residuals/Jacobians, covariance and failures. Controls are the literal FitControls request in frozen run.py; the standalone termination field was not serialized and is not fabricated retroactively.
final_cost_note: iteration_costs records Ceres iteration-summary costs, whereas the returned final_cost/physical/weighted_residuals are published from a separate final candidate evaluation (fit.cpp:955-969). For larger F1-B the last history cost31.143982910674143 differs from returned final_cost31.10960757917603; exact candidate replay agrees within declared1e-8 tolerances. Both values are retained rather than equated.
